company.name: Subsbase
company.shortDescription: Empower your business with Subsbase: the intuitive recurring revenue and subscription management platform for revenue growth.
company.description: SubsBase is a cloud-based subscription and billing platform. That provides operational, analytics, and billing tools to subscription-based businesses to efficiently manage their subscribers, removing the entire overhead of subscriber lifecycle management from the business and core products and services.

productsAndServices.description: A cloud-based platform for managing subscription billing, payments, and customer subscriptions across various business models.
productsAndServices.name: Subsbase Recurring Revenue Management Platform

productsAndServices.description: A payment processing system that consolidates and routes payments through multiple channels, currencies, and providers.
productsAndServices.name: Omni-channel Payment Collection Solution

productsAndServices.description: A tool for managing subscriber accounts, subscription plans, upgrades, downgrades, pauses, and cancellations.
productsAndServices.name: Subscription Management Module

productsAndServices.description: A system that automates invoice generation, billing cycles, and payment collection for recurring and one-time payments.
productsAndServices.name: Automated Billing and Invoicing System

productsAndServices.description: A suite of analytics and reporting features to track subscription metrics, revenue, churn, and customer behavior.
productsAndServices.name: Analytics and Reporting Tools

productsAndServices.description: APIs and integration capabilities to connect Subsbase with payment gateways, CRM, accounting, and other business systems.
productsAndServices.name: Integration and API Services

insights.title: Meaningful non-dilutive funding
insights.statement: 1 disclosed grants total $30,000, representing 1.15% of reported funding.
insights.implication: The grants reduce the share of reported financing attributed to equity or notes, although their restrictions and milestone requirements need separate verification.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $1,714,298 to $11,502,047, a 6.71x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 31 (-1 over 90 days) and market heat at 55 (-7).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.

insights.title: Competitive benchmark reflects the modeled peer set
insights.statement: Crunchbase’s closest modeled peers include Stripe, Zuora, Chargebee.
insights.implication: These matches provide a starting point for comparing differentiation, scale, and shared specialties, but they should not be treated as a verified competitor set.
caveats: Similarity scores are algorithmic matches, not verified direct competitors.
